facilities.answer: Toilets are at the back of the store, behind Aisle 9.
The service desk is at the front, right of the entrance. Returns and exchanges are done there.
Click & Collect orders are picked up at the service desk, front right.
Fitting rooms are next to Aisle 17, in clothing.
Checkouts are at the front of the store, by the entrance.
Trolleys and baskets are just inside the entrance.
